transcript_availability_note: No freely available earnings call transcript exists for any Heineken event. Heineken publishes investor presentations (slide decks) but does not make call transcripts freely available in English. All four events are therefore press-release-only in the model arm. The human arm also read the investor presentation for all four events, not a transcript. Both arms are on the same information set. Heineken events are excluded from Item C (four-arm section ablation) by document availability, not by choice. Determined 2026-08-13 during extension document gathering, before any Heineken event was scored.
